title: Embedded Security Research Portfolio
description: Seven embedded security projects (FreeRTOS-MPU hardening on ARM Cortex-M4, U-Boot secure boot, firmware patch diffing, Modbus ICS fuzzing, ARM malware sandbox, AES-128 side-channel analysis, and RISC-V PMP task isolation), plus a comparative study of ARM MPU vs RISC-V PMP task isolation with real-hardware validation.
